description: Capability for the floating presence overlay window: it drags itself and resizes to fit the HUD card. Maximize is denied on purpose: core:default grants internal-toggle-maximize (the drag-region double-click), and on macOS tao maximizes an undecorated window with an animated setFrame: that runs an NSAnimation on a background thread, which corrupted the panel's animation bookkeeping and aborted the app (KVO 'not registered' in NSAnimationManager).
